title: Return recorded before crossing
body: The last route time is written after the gate closed. A child's sticker covers the lunchbox label; the form counts returned clipboards, not people.
rival_reading: A delayed farm delivery could cross a work gate after a routine closure; an ordinary property count may omit the driver without showing a failed cordon.
gloss: A route record places a crossing after closure while completing a count of returned property.

title: Two measures, one return
body: The bucket has marks from a field round and after a road diversion. A child's drawing is folded under the handle; the capped bottle sits beside it. The only checked box asks if the bucket came back.
rival_reading: Emergency staff could measure and inventory water after a diversion; a returned container does not show that a program caused the outbreak.
gloss: A field-related measure and a later return entry remain with a pair of water containers.
